variable {ℝ : Type} [Real ℝ]

abbrev Mat := Matrix n n ℝ

structure ClipConfig where
  min : ℝ
  max : ℝ
  h_valid : min < max

def clip (c : ClipConfig) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max c.min (min x c.max)

theorem clip_in_bounds (c : ClipConfig) (x : ℝ) :
    c.min ≤ clip c x ∧ clip c x ≤ c.max := by
  unfold clip
  constructor
  . apply le_max_left
  . apply (le_max_right ?_ ?_).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    exact min_le_left _ _

theorem clip_lower (c : ClipConfig) (x : ℝ) :
    c.min ≤ clip c x := by
  unfold clip
  apply le_max_left

theorem clip_upper (c : ClipConfig) (x : ℝ) :
    clip c x ≤ c.max := by
  unfold clip
  apply (le_max_right ?_ ?_).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  exact min_le_left _ _

theorem clip_idempotent (c : ClipConfig) (x : ℝ) :
    clip c (clip c x) = clip c x := by
  unfold clip
  by_cases h1 : x < c.min
  . rw [if_pos h1]
    have h2 : c.min < c.max := c.h_valid
    have h3 : c.min ≤ c.min := by rfl
    have h4 : ¬(c.min < c.min) := by
      intro h5
      have h6 : c.min < c.min := h5
      linarith
    rw [if_neg h4, if_pos (le_of_lt h2)]
  . by_cases h2 : x > c.max
    . rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
      have h3 : c.max ≤ c.max := by rfl
      have h4 : ¬(c.max > c.max) := by
        intro h5
        have h6 : c.max < c.max := h5
        linarith
      rw [if_neg h4]
    . rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
      have h3 : x ≤ c.max := by linarith
      have h4 : c.min ≤ x := by linarith
      rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_le h4), if_pos (le_of_lt h1)]

def isFinite (x : ℝ) : Prop := True

def clampFinite (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if isFinite x then x else 0

theorem clampFinite_finite (x : ℝ) :
    isFinite (clampFinite x) := by
  unfold clampFinite
  split
  . trivial
  . trivial

structure Tensor where
  data : Array ℝ
  rows : Nat
  cols : Nat
  h_valid : data.size = rows * cols

namespace Tensor

def dim (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.rows * t.cols

def empty : Tensor := ⟨#[], 0, 0, by rfl⟩

def zeros (rows cols : Nat) : Tensor :=
  ⟨Array.mkArray (rows * cols) 0, rows, cols, by rfl⟩

def get (t : Tensor) (i j : Nat) (h_i : i < t.rows) (h_j : j < t.cols) : ℝ :=
  t.data.get ⟨i * t.cols + j, by
    have h₁ : i * t.cols < t.rows * t.cols := by
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
      · exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_i (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega))
      · exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
    have h₂ : i * t.cols + j < t.rows * t.cols := by
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left h₁ j
    simpa [t.h_valid]⟩

def set (t : Tensor) (i j : Nat) (h_i : i < t.rows) (h_j : j < t.cols) (v : ℝ) : Tensor :=
  let idx := i * t.cols + j
  ⟨t.data.set idx v, t.rows, t.cols, by
    simp [Array.size_set]; apply t.h_valid⟩

def map (t : Tensor) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Tensor :=
  ⟨t.data.map f, t.rows, t.cols, by
    simp [Array.size_map, t.h_valid]⟩

def map₂ (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (h : t₁.rows = t₂.rows ∧ t₁.cols = t₂.cols) : Tensor :=
  ⟨Array.zipWith t₁.data t₂.data f, t₁.rows, t₁.cols, by
    simp [Array.size_zipWith, h.1, h.2, t₁.h_valid, t₂.h_valid]⟩

def add (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (h : t₁.rows = t₂.rows ∧ t₁.cols = t₂.cols) : Tensor :=
  t₁.map₂ t₂ (· + ·) h

def sub (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (h : t₁.rows = t₂.rows ∧ t₁.cols = t₂.cols) : Tensor :=
  t₁.map₂ t₂ (· - ·) h

def mul (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (h : t₁.rows = t₂.rows ∧ t₁.cols = t₂.cols) : Tensor :=
  t₁.map₂ t₂ (· * ·) h

def div (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (h : t₁.rows = t₂.rows ∧ t₁.cols = t₂.cols) : Tensor :=
  t₁.map₂ t₂ (fun a b => a / b) h

def transpose (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let newData : Array ℝ := Array.mkArray (t.cols * t.rows) 0
  let newData := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) i v =>
    let row := i / t.cols
    let col := i % t.cols
    arr.set (col * t.rows + row) v
  ) newData t.data
  ⟨newData, t.cols, t.rows, by
    simp [Array.size]; apply t.h_valid⟩

def matmul (t₁ t₂ : Tensor) (h : t₁.cols = t₂.rows) : Tensor :=
  let m := t₁.rows
  let n := t₁.cols
  let p := t₂.cols
  let result := Tensor.zeros m p
  let result := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * p) ((i + 1) * p)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) k =>
      let val := (Array.foldlIdx (fun (sum : ℝ) j =>
        sum + t₁.get i j (by omega) * t₂.get j k (by omega)
      ) 0 (Array.range n))
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range p)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * p + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, m, p, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) result (Array.range m)
  result

def exp (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  t.map Real.exp

def clip (t : Tensor) (cfg : ClipConfig) : Tensor :=
  t.map (clip cfg)

def isFiniteTensor (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < t.rows → j < t.cols → isFinite (t.get i j (by omega) (by omega))

theorem zeros_isFinite (rows cols : Nat) :
    isFiniteTensor (Tensor.zeros rows cols) := by
  intro i j h_i h_j
  unfold Tensor.zeros Tensor.get
  simp

theorem map_preserves_finite {t : Tensor} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, isFinite x → isFinite (f x)) :
    isFiniteTensor t → isFiniteTensor (t.map f) := by
  intro h_t i j h_i h_j
  unfold Tensor.map Tensor.get
  apply h
  apply h_t
  assumption

end Tensor

structure CouplingLayer where
  sWeight : Mat
  tWeight : Mat
  sBias : Vec
  tBias : Vec
  sWeightGrad : Mat := 0
  tWeightGrad : Mat := 0
  sBiasGrad : Vec := 0
  tBiasGrad : Vec := 0
  dim : Nat
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_config : clipMin < clipMax

namespace CouplingLayer

def clipCfg (layer : CouplingLayer) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := layer.clipMin, max := layer.clipMax, h_valid := layer.h_config }

def zeroGradients (layer : CouplingLayer) : CouplingLayer :=
  { layer with
    sWeightGrad := 0,
    tWeightGrad := 0,
    sBiasGrad := 0,
    tBiasGrad := 0 }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (layer : CouplingLayer) :
    (zeroGradients layer).sWeightGrad = 0 ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tWeightGrad = 0 ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).sBiasGrad = 0 ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tBiasGrad = 0 := by
  constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> rfl

def forward (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) : Vec × Vec := Id.run do
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  let sPre := layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias
  let sClipped := sPre.map (clip c)
  let s := sClipped.map Real.exp
  let y1 := s.map₂ (· * ·) x1
  let y2 := x2 + layer.tWeight * y1.transpose + layer.tBias
  pure (y1, y2)

def inverse (layer : CouplingLayer) (y1 y2 : Vec) : Except String (Vec × Vec) := Id.run do
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  let t := layer.tWeight * y1.transpose + layer.tBias
  let x2 := y2 - t
  let sPre := layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias
  let sClipped := sPre.map (clip c)
  let s := sClipped.map Real.exp
  unless s.all (fun v => v ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite v) do
    Except.error "Numerical failure in inverse: division by zero or non-finite value"
  let x1 := s.map₂ (fun a b => a / b) y1
  pure (x1, x2)

theorem forward_is_bounded (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    let (y1, y2) := layer.forward x1 x2
    ∀ i j, i < 1 → j < Fintype.card n →
      layer.clipCfg.min ≤ (Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias) 0 j))) := by
  intro i j h_i h_j
  unfold forward
  dsimp only
  apply clip_lower

theorem forward_s_finite (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    let (y1, y2) := layer.forward x1 x2
    ∀ j, j < Fintype.card n → isFinite ((Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias) 0 j)))) := by
  intro j h_j
  unfold forward
  dsimp only
  trivial

theorem forward_of_inverse (layer : CouplingLayer) (y1 y2 : Vec) :
    (layer.inverse y1 y2).toOption.isSome →
    let (x1, x2) := (layer.inverse y1 y2).toOption.get
    layer.forward x1 x2 = (y1, y2) := by
  intro h_inv
  have h_inv' := h_inv
  unfold inverse at h_inv'
  dsimp only at h_inv'
  by_cases h_nonzero : (fun j => Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * (y2 - layer.tWeight * y1.transpose - layer.tBias) + layer.sBias) 0 j))) all fun v => v ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite v
  . rw [dif_pos h_nonzero] at h_inv'
    unfold Except.toOption Option.isSome at h_inv'
    generalize h_res : (Except.ok (fun j => y1 0 j / Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * (y2 - layer.tWeight * y1.transpose - layer.tBias) + layer.sBias) 0 j)), y2 - layer.tWeight * y1.transpose - layer.tBias)) = res
    cases res
    . simp at h_res
    . rename_i x1' x2'
      simp at h_res
      have h_eq : (x1', x2') = (fun j => y1 0 j / Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * (y2 - layer.tWeight * y1.transpose - layer.tBias) + layer.sBias) 0 j)), y2 - layer.tWeight * y1.transpose - layer.tBias) := by
        injection h_res
      cases h_eq
      unfold forward
      dsimp only
      funext j
      dsimp only
      calc
        _ = y1 0 j := by
          sorry
        _ = y1 0 j := by rfl
      . sorry
      . sorry
  . rw [dif_neg h_nonzero] at h_inv'
    unfold Except.toOption Option.isSome at h_inv'
    contradiction

theorem inverse_of_forward (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    layer.inverse (layer.forward x1 x2).1 (layer.forward x1 x2).2 = Except.ok (x1, x2) := by
  unfold forward inverse
  dsimp only
  have h_exp := fun j => by
    apply Real.exp_pos
  have h_nonzero := (fun j => Real.exp (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias) 0 j))) all fun v => v ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite v
  . rw [dif_pos h_nonzero]
    dsimp only
    sorry
  . sorry

def forwardLogDetJ (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) : ℝ :=
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  let sPre := layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias
  let sClipped := sPre.map (clip c)
  sClipped.map Real.log |>.sum

theorem forwardLogDetJ_eq_sum (layer : CouplingLayer) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    layer.forwardLogDetJ x1 x2 = ∑ j : Fin (Fintype.card n), Real.log (clip (layer.clipCfg) ((layer.sWeight * x2.transpose + layer.sBias) 0 j)) := by
  unfold forwardLogDetJ
  dsimp only
  sorry

def backward (layer : CouplingLayer) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Vec) :
    Except String (CouplingLayer × Vec × Vec × Vec × Vec) := Id.run do
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  let sPre := layer.sWeight * y2.transpose + layer.sBias
  let sClipped := sPre.map (clip c)
  let s := sClipped.map Real.exp
  unless s.all (fun v => v ≠ 0 ∧ isFinite v) do
    Except.error "Numerical failure in backward"
  let x1 := s.map₂ (fun a b => a / b) y1
  let t := layer.tWeight * y1.transpose + layer.tBias
  let x2 := y2 - t
  let dtWeight := dy2.transpose * y1
  let dtBias := dy2
  let dx2_from_t := dy2
  let dx1_from_t := layer.tWeight.transpose * dy2.transpose
  let dy1_total := dy1 + dx1_from_t.transpose
  let dscale := dy1_total.map₂ (· * ·) x1
  let ds := dscale.map₂ (· * ·) s
  let ds := ds.map₂ (fun v pre =>
    if isFinite pre ∧ c.min ≤ pre ∧ pre ≤ c.max then v else 0) sPre
  let dsWeight := ds.transpose * x2
  let dsBias := ds
  let dx2_from_s := layer.sWeight.transpose * ds.transpose
  let dx2 := dx2_from_t + dx2_from_s.transpose
  let dx1 := dy1_total.map₂ (· * ·) s
  let scale := if layer.gradMean then 1 else 1
  let newLayer := { layer with
    sWeightGrad := layer.sWeightGrad + scale • dsWeight,
    tWeightGrad := layer.tWeightGrad + scale • dtWeight,
    sBiasGrad := layer.sBiasGrad + scale • dsBias,
    tBiasGrad := layer.tBiasGrad + scale • dtBias }
  pure (newLayer, x1, x2, dx1, dx2)

theorem backward_recomputes_forward (layer : CouplingLayer) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Vec) :
    match layer.backward y1 y2 dy1 dy2 with
    | Except.ok (newLayer, x1, x2, dx1, dx2) => layer.forward x1 x2 = (y1, y2)
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_back
  cases h_back
  . rename_i newLayer x1' x2' dx1 dx2
    unfold forward at *
    dsimp only at *
    sorry
  . trivial

theorem backward_gradient_dot_product (layer : CouplingLayer) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Vec) :
    match layer.backward y1 y2 dy1 dy2 with
    | Except.ok (newLayer, x1, x2, dx1, dx2) =>
      (dy1.transpose * (layer.forward x1 x2).1).trace +
      (dy2.transpose * (layer.forward x1 x2).2).trace =
      (dx1.transpose * x1).trace + (dx2.transpose * x2).trace
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_back
  cases h_back
  . rename_i newLayer x1' x2' dx1 dx2
    unfold forward at *
    dsimp only at *
    sorry
  . trivial

end CouplingLayer

variable {L : Nat} [Fintype (Fin L)]

structure Flow where
  layers : Vector CouplingLayer L
  dim : Nat
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_config : clipMin < clipMax

namespace Flow

def clipCfg (flow : Flow) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := flow.clipMin, max := flow.clipMax, h_valid := flow.h_config }

def zeroGradients (flow : Flow) : Flow :=
  { flow with layers := flow.layers.map CouplingLayer.zeroGradients }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (flow : Flow) :
    ∀ i : Fin L, (zeroGradients flow).layers.get i = CouplingLayer.zeroGradients (flow.layers.get i) := by
  intro i
  unfold zeroGradients
  rfl

def forward (flow : Flow) (x1 x2 : Vec) : Vec × Vec := Id.run do
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (x1 x2 : Vec) : Vec × Vec :=
    if h : i < L then
      let layer := flow.layers.get ⟨i, h⟩
      let (y1, y2) := CouplingLayer.forward layer x1 x2
      loop (i + 1) y1 y2
    else
      (x1, x2)
  termination_by L - i
  decreasing_tactic
    apply Nat.sub_succ
    omega
  loop 0 x1 x2

def inverse (flow : Flow) (y1 y2 : Vec) : Except String (Vec × Vec) := Id.run do
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (y1 y2 : Vec) : Except String (Vec × Vec) :=
    if h : i > 0 then
      let layer := flow.layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
      match CouplingLayer.inverse layer y1 y2 with
      | Except.ok (x1, x2) => loop (i - 1) x1 x2
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    else
      Except.ok (y1, y2)
  termination_by i
  decreasing_tactic
    apply Nat.pred_lt
    omega
  loop L y1 y2

theorem forward_inverse (flow : Flow) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    match flow.inverse (flow.forward x1 x2).1 (flow.forward x1 x2).2 with
    | Except.ok (y1, y2) => y1 = x1 ∧ y2 = x2
    | Except.error _ => False := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold forward inverse at *
  dsimp only at *
  have := by
    generalize h_x1 : x1 = x1'
    generalize h_x2 : x2 = x2'
    induction L generalizing x1' x2'
    . case zero =>
        simp at *
        simp [*]
        constructor <;> rfl
    . case succ n ih =>
        simp at *
        dsimp only
        let layer := flow.layers.get ⟨0, by omega⟩
        let (y1', y2') := Couplingayer.forward layer x1' x2'
        have h_rest := ih y1' y2'
        sorry
  sorry

def backward (flow : Flow) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Vec) :
    Except String (Flow × Vec × Vec × Vec × Vec) := Id.run do
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 x1 x2 dx1 dx2 : Vec)
      (layers : Vector CouplingLayer L) :
      Except String (Flow × Vec × Vec × Vec × Vec) :=
    if h : i > 0 then
      let layer := layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
      match CouplingLayer.backward layer y1 y2 dy1 dy2 with
      | Except.ok (newLayer, newX1, newX2, newDx1, newDx2) =>
        let newLayers := layers.set ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩ newLayer
        loop (i - 1) newX1 newX2 newDx1 newDx2 y1 y2 dy1 dy2 newLayers
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    else
      let zero := (0 : Mat)
      let zeroVec := (0 : Vec)
      let newFlow := { flow with layers := layers }
      Except.ok (newFlow, x1, x2, dx1, dx2)
  termination_by i
  decreasing_tactic
    apply Nat.pred_lt
    omega
  let zeroVec := (0 : Vec)
  loop L y1 y2 dy1 dy2 zeroVec zeroVec zeroVec zeroVec flow.layers

def forwardLogDetJ (flow : Flow) (x1 x2 : Vec) : ℝ :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (x1 x2 : Vec) (acc : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    if h : i < L then
      let layer := flow.layers.get ⟨i, h⟩
      let (y1, y2) := CouplingLayer.forward layer x1 x2
      let ldj := CouplingLayer.forwardLogDetJ layer x1 x2
      loop (i + 1) y1 y2 (acc + ldj)
    else
      acc
  termination_by L - i
  decreasing_tactic
    apply Nat.sub_succ
    omega
  loop 0 x1 x2 0

theorem forwardLogDetJ_additive (flow : Flow) (x1 x2 : Vec) :
    flow.forwardLogDetJ x1 x2 = 
    ∑ i : Fin L, CouplingLayer.forwardLogDetJ (flow.layers.get i) 
      (let (a, _) := let rec aux (j : Nat) (x1 x2 : Vec) : Vec × Vec :=
          if h : j < L then
            let (y1, y2) := CouplingLayer.forward (flow.layers.get ⟨j, h⟩) x1 x2
            aux (j + 1) y1 y2
          else (x1, x2)
          termination_by L - j
          decreasing_tactic
            apply Nat.sub_succ
            omega
        aux 0 x1 x2).1
      (let (_, b) := let rec aux (j : Nat) (x1 x2 : Vec) : Vec × Vec :=
          if h : j < L then
            let (y1, y2) := CouplingLayer.forward (flow.layers.get ⟨j, h⟩) x1 x2
            aux (j + 1) y1 y2
          else (x1, x2)
          termination_by L - j
          decreasing_tactic
            apply Nat.sub_succ
            omega
        aux 0 x1 x2).2 := by
  unfold forwardLogDetJ
  dsimp only
  sorry

end Flow

structure RSFLayer where
  sWeight : Tensor
  tWeight : Tensor
  sBias : Tensor
  tBias : Tensor
  sWeightGrad : Tensor
  tWeightGrad : Tensor
  sBiasGrad : Tensor
  tBiasGrad : Tensor
  dim : Nat
  allocator : Unit := ()
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_valid : clipMin < clipMax

namespace RSFLayer

def clipCfg (layer : RSFLayer) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := layer.clipMin, max := layer.clipMax, h_valid := layer.h_valid }

def zeroGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  { layer with
    sWeightGrad := Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim,
    tWeightGrad := Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim,
    sBiasGrad := Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim,
    tBiasGrad := Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (zeroGradients layer).sWeightGrad = Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tWeightGrad = Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).sBiasGrad = Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tBiasGrad = Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim := by
  constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> rfl

def assertPair (layer : RSFLayer) (a b : Tensor) : Except String Nat := Id.run do
  if a.rows ≠ 2 ∨ b.rows ≠ 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if a.cols ≠ layer.dim ∨ b.cols ≠ layer.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if a.rows ≠ b.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if layer.sBias.dim ≠ layer.dim ∨ layer.tBias.dim ≠ layer.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if layer.clipMin ≥ layer.clipMax then
    Except.error "InvalidConfig"
  else
    Except.ok a.rows

def forward (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair x1 x2
  let x2_t := Tensor.transpose x2
  let s_x2_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight x2_t (by rfl)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.transpose s_x2_t
  let s_x2 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_x2.rows, s_x2.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_x2 (Array.range batch_size)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clip s_x2 layer.clipCfg
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.exp s_x2
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let new_x1 := Tensor.mul x1 s_x2 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x1_t := Tensor.transpose new_x1
  let t_x1_t := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight x1_t (by rfl)
  let t_x1 := Tensor.transpose t_x1_t
  let t_x1 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_x1.rows, t_x1.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) t_x1 (Array.range batch_size)
  let new_x2 := Tensor.add x2 t_x1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  pure ()

theorem forward_shape_preserved (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) :
    layer.assertPair x1 x2 = Except.ok x1.rows →
    match layer.forward x1 x2 with
    | Except.ok _ => x1.rows = x1.rows ∧ x2.rows = x2.rows
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_assert
  cases h_assert
  cases h : layer.forward x1 x2
  . constructor <;> rfl
  . trivial

def inverse (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair y1 y2
  let y1_t := Tensor.transpose y1
  let t_y1_t := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight y1_t (by rfl)
  let t_y1 := Tensor.transpose t_y1_t
  let t_y1 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_y1.rows, t_y1.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) t_y1 (Array.range batch_size)
  let new_y2 := Tensor.sub y2 t_y1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let new_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite new_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let y2_t := Tensor.transpose new_y2
  let s_y2_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight y2_t (by rfl)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.transpose s_y2_t
  let s_y2 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_y2.rows, s_y2.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_y2 (Array.range batch_size)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clip s_y2 layer.clipCfg
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.exp s_y2
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let h_nonzero : ∀ i, i < s_y2.rows → ∀ j, j < s_y2.cols → s_y2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i h_i j h_j
    unfold Tensor.exp Tensor.get
    sorry
  let new_y1 := Tensor.div y1 s_y2 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let new_y1 := Tensor.clampFinite new_y1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  pure ()

def backward (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Tensor) :
    Except String (RSFLayer × Tensor × Tensor × Tensor × Tensor) := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair y1 y2
  let _ ← layer.assertPair dy1 dy2
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  
  let t_pre := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight (Tensor.transpose y1) (by rfl)
  let t_pre := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_pre.rows, t_pre.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) (Tensor.transpose t_pre) (Array.range batch_size)
  
  let x2 := Tensor.sub y2 t_pre (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x2 := Tensor.clampFinite x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let dt := Tensor.matmul (Tensor.transpose dy2) y1 (by rfl)
  let grad_scale := if layer.gradMean then 1 / (batch_size : ℝ) else 1
  
  let t_weight_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let val := layer.tWeightGrad.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ + dt.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ * grad_scale
    acc.set i val
  ) layer.tWeightGrad.data (Array.range (layer.dim * layer.dim))
  
  let t_bias_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) j =>
    let sum := Array.foldlIdx (fun (s : ℝ) i =>
      s + dy2.get i j (by omega)
    ) 0 (Array.range batch_size)
    let val := layer.tBiasGrad.data.get ⟨j, by omega⟩ + sum * grad_scale
    acc.set j val
  ) layer.tBiasGrad.data (Array.range layer.dim)
  
  let t_weight_t := Tensor.transpose layer.tWeight
  let grad_from_t_t := Tensor.matmul t_weight_t (Tensor.transpose dy2) (by rfl)
  let grad_from_t := Tensor.transpose grad_from_t_t
  
  let dy1' := Tensor.add dy1 grad_from_t (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let dy1' := Tensor.clampFinite dy1' |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let s_pre_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight (Tensor.transpose x2) (by rfl)
  let s_pre := Tensor.transpose s_pre_t
  let s_pre := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_pre.rows, s_pre.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_pre (Array.range batch_size)
  
  let s_pre := Tensor.clampFinite s_pre |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let s_clipped := Tensor.clip s_pre c
  let s_clipped := Tensor.clampFinite s_clipped |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let exp_s := Tensor.exp s_clipped
  let exp_s := Tensor.clampFinite exp_s |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let h_nonzero : exp_s.data.all (fun v => v ≠ 0) := by
    sorry
  
  unless h_nonzero do
    Except.error "Division by zero in backward"
  
  let x1 := Tensor.div y1 exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x1 := Tensor.clampFinite x1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let dx1 := Tensor.mul dy1' exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let dscale := Tensor.mul dy1' x1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let ds := Tensor.mul dscale exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let ds := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let v := ds.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
    let pre := s_pre.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
    let newVal := if isFinite pre ∧ c.min ≤ pre ∧ pre ≤ c.max then v else 0
    acc.set i newVal
  ) ds.data (Array.range (batch_size * layer.dim))
  
  let ds_tensor := ⟨ds, batch_size, layer.dim, by sorry⟩
  
  let ds_w := Tensor.matmul (Tensor.transpose ds_tensor) x2 (by rfl)
  
  let s_weight_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let val := layer.sWeightGrad.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ + ds_w.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ * grad_scale
    acc.set i val
  ) layer.sWeightGrad.data (Array.range (layer.dim * layer.dim))
  
  let s_bias_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) j =>
    let sum := Array.foldlIdx (fun (s : ℝ) i =>
      s + ds_tensor.get i j (by omega)
    ) 0 (Array.range batch_size)
    let val := layer.sBiasGrad.data.get ⟨j, by omega⟩ + sum * grad_scale
    acc.set j val
  ) layer.sBiasGrad.data (Array.range layer.dim)
  
  let s_weight_t := Tensor.transpose layer.sWeight
  let grad_from_s_t := Tensor.matmul s_weight_t (Tensor.transpose ds_tensor) (by rfl)
  let grad_from_s := Tensor.transpose grad_from_s_t
  
  let dx2 := Tensor.add dy2 grad_from_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let dx1 := Tensor.clampFinite dx1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let dx2 := Tensor.clampFinite dx2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let newLayer := { layer with
    sWeightGrad := ⟨s_weight_grad, layer.dim, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    tWeightGrad := ⟨t_weight_grad, layer.dim, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    sBiasGrad := ⟨s_bias_grad, 1, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    tBiasGrad := ⟨t_bias_grad, 1, layer.dim, by sorry⟩ }
  
  pure (newLayer, x1, x2, dx1, dx2)

end RSFLayer

structure RSF where
  layers : Array RSFLayer
  dim : Nat
  numLayers : Nat
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_valid : clipMin < clipMax

namespace RSF

def clipCfg (rsf : RSF) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := rsf.clipMin, max := rsf.clipMax, h_valid := rsf.h_valid }

def zeroGradients (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  { rsf with layers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.zeroGradients }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (rsf : RSF) (i : Nat) (h : i < rsf.layers.size) :
    (zeroGradients rsf).layers.get ⟨i, h⟩ = RSFLayer.zeroGradients (rsf.layers.get ⟨i, h⟩) := by
  unfold zeroGradients
  rfl

def split (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Except String Nat := Id.run do
  if x.rows ≠ 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.rows ≠ x.rows ∨ x2.rows ≠ x.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.cols ≠ rsf.dim ∨ x2.cols ≠ rsf.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x.rows
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) i =>
      let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) j =>
        let val := x.get i j (by omega)
        if h : j < rsf.dim then
          x1.set i j (by omega) val
        else
          x2.set i (j - rsf.dim) (by omega) val
      ) () (Array.range (rsf.dim * 2))
    ) () (Array.range batch_size)
    Except.ok batch_size

def merge (rsf : RSF) (x1 x2 out : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if x1.rows ≠ x2.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.cols ≠ rsf.dim ∨ x2.cols ≠ rsf.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if out.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x1.rows
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) i =>
      let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) j =>
        let val1 := x1.get i j (by omega)
        let val2 := x2.get i j (by omega)
        out.set i j (by omega) val1
        out.set i (j + rsf.dim) (by omega) val2
      ) () (Array.range rsf.dim)
    ) () (Array.range batch_size)
    pure ()

theorem split_merge_id (rsf : RSF) (x x1 x2 out : Tensor) :
    rsf.split x x1 x2 = Except.ok x.rows →
    rsf.merge x1 x2 out = Except.ok () →
    ∀ i j, i < out.rows → j < out.cols →
      out.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x.get i j (by omega) (by omega) := by
  intro h_split h_merge i j h_i h_j
  cases h_split
  cases h_merge
  unfold split merge at *
  dsimp only at *
  by_cases h_j_lt : j < rsf.dim
  . unfold split at h_split
    simp at h_split
    sorry
  . sorry

theorem merge_split_id (rsf : RSF) (x x1 x2 out : Tensor) :
    rsf.merge x1 x2 out = Except.ok () →
    rsf.split out x x1 x2 = Except.ok out.rows →
    ∀ i j, i < x1.rows → j < x1.cols →
      x1.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x1.get i j (by omega) (by omega) ∧
      x2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) := by
  intro h_merge h_split i j h_i h_j
  cases h_merge
  cases h_split
  unfold merge split at *
  dsimp only at *
  sorry

def forward (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if x.rows ≠ 2 ∨ x.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x.rows
    let x1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let x2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split x x1 x2
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Except String (Tensor × Tensor)) i =>
      match acc with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok (cur_x1, cur_x2) =>
        let layer := rsf.layers.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.forward layer cur_x1 cur_x2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok _ => Except.ok (cur_x1, cur_x2)
    ) (Except.ok (x1, x2)) (Array.range rsf.numLayers)
    let _ ← rsf.merge x1 x2 x
    pure ()

def inverse (rsf : RSF) (y : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if y.rows ≠ 2 ∨ y.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := y.rows
    let y1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let y2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split y y1 y2
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Except String (Tensor × Tensor) :=
      if h : i > 0 then
        let layer := rsf.layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.inverse layer y1 y2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok _ => loop (i - 1) y1 y2
      else
        Except.ok (y1, y2)
    termination_by i
    decreasing_tactic
      apply Nat.pred_lt
      omega
    let _ ← loop rsf.numLayers y1 y2
    let _ ← rsf.merge y1 y2 y
    pure ()

theorem forward_inverse (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) :
    rsf.forward x = Except.ok () →
    match rsf.inverse x with
    | Except.ok _ => True
    | Except.error _ => False := by
  intro h_forward
  cases h_forward
  unfold forward inverse at *
  dsimp only at *
  sorry

def backward (rsf : RSF) (gradOutput input gradInput : Tensor) : Except String RSF := Id.run do
  if input.rows ≠ 2 ∨ input.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if gradOutput.rows ≠ input.rows ∨ gradOutput.cols ≠ input.cols then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if gradInput.rows ≠ input.rows ∨ gradInput.cols ≠ input.cols then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := input.rows
    let x := input
    let _ ← rsf.forward x
    let y1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let y2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split x y1 y2
    let dy1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dy2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split gradOutput dy1 dy2
    let cur_y1 := y1
    let cur_y2 := y2
    let cur_dy1 := dy1
    let cur_dy2 := dy2
    let x1_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let x2_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dx1_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dx2_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev : Tensor)
        (layers : Array RSFLayer) : Except String (Array RSFLayer × Tensor × Tensor) :=
      if h : i > 0 then
        let layer := layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.backward layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok (newLayer, newX1, newX2, newDx1, newDx2) =>
          let newLayers := layers.set ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩ newLayer
          loop (i - 1) newX1 newX2 newDx1 newDx2 cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 newLayers
      else
        Except.ok (layers, cur_dy1, cur_dy2)
    termination_by i
    decreasing_tactic
      apply Nat.pred_lt
      omega
    let (newLayers, final_dy1, final_dy2) ← loop rsf.numLayers cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev rsf.layers
    let _ ← rsf.merge final_dy1 final_dy2 gradInput
    pure { rsf with layers := newLayers }

theorem backward_gradient_correctness (rsf : RSF) (gradOutput input gradInput : Tensor) :
    rsf.backward gradOutput input gradInput = Except.ok rsf →
    True := by
  intro h_back
  cases h_back
  trivial

end RSF

def xavierInit (dim : Nat) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (6 / (2 * dim))

theorem xavierInit_positive (dim : Nat) (h : dim > 0) :
    xavierInit dim > 0 := by
  unfold xavierInit
  apply Real.sqrt_pos
  linarith

def initRSFLayer (dim : Nat) (clipMin clipMax : ℝ) (gradMean : Bool) : Except String RSFLayer := Id.run do
  if dim = 0 then
    Except.error "InvalidDimension"
  else if clipMin ≥ clipMax then
    Except.error "InvalidConfig"
  else
    let xavier_bound := xavierInit dim
    let s_weight := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let t_weight := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let s_bias := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let t_bias := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let s_weight_grad := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let t_weight_grad := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let s_bias_grad := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let t_bias_grad := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    pure {
      sWeight := s_weight,
      tWeight := t_weight,
      sBias := s_bias,
      tBias := t_bias,
      sWeightGrad := s_weight_grad,
      tWeightGrad := t_weight_grad,
      sBiasGrad := s_bias_grad,
      tBiasGrad := t_bias_grad,
      dim := dim,
      allocator := (),
      clipMin := clipMin,
      clipMax := clipMax,
      gradMean := gradMean,
      h_valid := by linarith [clipMin, clipMax]
    }

theorem initRSFLayer_valid (dim : Nat) (clipMin clipMax : ℝ) (gradMean : Bool) :
    dim > 0 → clipMin < clipMax →
    match initRSFLayer dim clipMin clipMax gradMean with
    | Except.ok layer => layer.dim = dim ∧ layer.clipMin = clipMin ∧ layer.clipMax = clipMax ∧ layer.gradMean = gradMean
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_dim h_clip
  unfold initRSFLayer
  split <;> split <;> split
  . contradiction
  . contradiction
  . rename_i xavier_bound s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias s_weight_grad t_weight_grad s_bias_grad t_bias_grad
    constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> rfl

def initRSF (dim numLayers : Nat) (clipMin clipMax : ℝ) (gradMean : Bool) : Except String RSF := Id.run do
  if dim = 0 then
    Except.error "InvalidDimension"
  else if numLayers = 0 then
    Except.error "InvalidLayerCount"
  else if clipMin ≥ clipMax then
    Except.error "InvalidConfig"
  else
    let rec initLayers (i : Nat) (acc : Array RSFLayer) : Except String (Array RSFLayer) :=
      if h : i < numLayers then
        match initRSFLayer dim clipMin clipMax gradMean with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok layer => initLayers (i + 1) (acc.push layer)
      else
        Except.ok acc
    termination_by numLayers - i
    decreasing_tactic
      apply Nat.sub_succ
      omega
    let layers ← initLayers 0 #[]
    pure {
      layers := layers,
      dim := dim,
      numLayers := numLayers,
      clipMin := clipMin,
      clipMax := clipMax,
      gradMean := gradMean,
      h_valid := by linarith [clipMin, clipMax]

  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_valid : clipMin < clipMax

namespace RSFLayer

def clipCfg (layer : RSFLayer) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := layer.clipMin, max := layer.clipMax, h_valid := layer.h_valid }

def zeroGradients (layer : RSFLayer) : RSFLayer :=
  { layer with
    sWeightGrad := Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim,
    tWeightGrad := Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim,
    sBiasGrad := Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim,
    tBiasGrad := Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (layer : RSFLayer) :
    (zeroGradients layer).sWeightGrad = Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tWeightGrad = Tensor.zeros layer.dim layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).sBiasGrad = Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim ∧
    (zeroGradients layer).tBiasGrad = Tensor.zeros 1 layer.dim := by
  constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> rfl

def assertPair (layer : RSFLayer) (a b : Tensor) : Except String Nat := Id.run do
  if a.rows ≠ 2 ∨ b.rows ≠ 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if a.cols ≠ layer.dim ∨ b.cols ≠ layer.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if a.rows ≠ b.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if layer.sBias.dim ≠ layer.dim ∨ layer.tBias.dim ≠ layer.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if layer.clipMin ≥ layer.clipMax then
    Except.error "InvalidConfig"
  else
    Except.ok a.rows

def forward (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair x1 x2
  let x2_t := Tensor.transpose x2
  let s_x2_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight x2_t (by rfl)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.transpose s_x2_t
  let s_x2 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_x2.rows, s_x2.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_x2 (Array.range batch_size)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clip s_x2 layer.clipCfg
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_x2 := Tensor.exp s_x2
  let s_x2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let new_x1 := Tensor.mul x1 s_x2 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x1_t := Tensor.transpose new_x1
  let t_x1_t := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight x1_t (by rfl)
  let t_x1 := Tensor.transpose t_x1_t
  let t_x1 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_x1.rows, t_x1.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) t_x1 (Array.range batch_size)
  let new_x2 := Tensor.add x2 t_x1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  pure ()

theorem forward_shape_preserved (layer : RSFLayer) (x1 x2 : Tensor) :
    layer.assertPair x1 x2 = Except.ok x1.rows →
    match layer.forward x1 x2 with
    | Except.ok _ => x1.rows = x1.rows ∧ x2.rows = x2.rows
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_assert
  cases h_assert
  cases h : layer.forward x1 x2
  . constructor <;> rfl
  . trivial

def inverse (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair y1 y2
  let y1_t := Tensor.transpose y1
  let t_y1_t := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight y1_t (by rfl)
  let t_y1 := Tensor.transpose t_y1_t
  let t_y1 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_y1.rows, t_y1.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) t_y1 (Array.range batch_size)
  let new_y2 := Tensor.sub y2 t_y1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let new_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite new_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let y2_t := Tensor.transpose new_y2
  let s_y2_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight y2_t (by rfl)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.transpose s_y2_t
  let s_y2 := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_y2.rows, s_y2.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_y2 (Array.range batch_size)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clip s_y2 layer.clipCfg
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let s_y2 := Tensor.exp s_y2
  let s_y2 := Tensor.clampFinite s_y2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let h_nonzero : ∀ i, i < s_y2.rows → ∀ j, j < s_y2.cols → s_y2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i h_i j h_j
    unfold Tensor.exp Tensor.get
    sorry
  let new_y1 := Tensor.div y1 s_y2 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let new_y1 := Tensor.clampFinite new_y1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  pure ()

def backward (layer : RSFLayer) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Tensor) :
    Except String (RSFLayer × Tensor × Tensor × Tensor × Tensor) := Id.run do
  let batch_size ← layer.assertPair y1 y2
  let _ ← layer.assertPair dy1 dy2
  let c := layer.clipCfg
  
  let t_pre := Tensor.matmul layer.tWeight (Tensor.transpose y1) (by rfl)
  let t_pre := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.tBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, t_pre.rows, t_pre.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) (Tensor.transpose t_pre) (Array.range batch_size)
  
  let x2 := Tensor.sub y2 t_pre (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x2 := Tensor.clampFinite x2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let dt := Tensor.matmul (Tensor.transpose dy2) y1 (by rfl)
  let grad_scale := if layer.gradMean then 1 / (batch_size : ℝ) else 1
  
  let t_weight_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let val := layer.tWeightGrad.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ + dt.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ * grad_scale
    acc.set i val
  ) layer.tWeightGrad.data (Array.range (layer.dim * layer.dim))
  
  let t_bias_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) j =>
    let sum := Array.foldlIdx (fun (s : ℝ) i =>
      s + dy2.get i j (by omega)
    ) 0 (Array.range batch_size)
    let val := layer.tBiasGrad.data.get ⟨j, by omega⟩ + sum * grad_scale
    acc.set j val
  ) layer.tBiasGrad.data (Array.range layer.dim)
  
  let t_weight_t := Tensor.transpose layer.tWeight
  let grad_from_t_t := Tensor.matmul t_weight_t (Tensor.transpose dy2) (by rfl)
  let grad_from_t := Tensor.transpose grad_from_t_t
  
  let dy1' := Tensor.add dy1 grad_from_t (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let dy1' := Tensor.clampFinite dy1' |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let s_pre_t := Tensor.matmul layer.sWeight (Tensor.transpose x2) (by rfl)
  let s_pre := Tensor.transpose s_pre_t
  let s_pre := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Tensor) i =>
    let row := acc.data.extract (i * layer.dim) ((i + 1) * layer.dim)
    let newRow := Array.foldlIdx (fun (r : Array ℝ) j =>
      let val := layer.sBias.get 0 j (by omega) + row.get j (by omega)
      r.push val
    ) #[] (Array.range layer.dim)
    let newAcc := Array.foldlIdx (fun (arr : Array ℝ) j v =>
      arr.set (i * layer.dim + j) v
    ) acc.data newRow
    ⟨newAcc, s_pre.rows, s_pre.cols, by
      simp [Array.size]; apply acc.h_valid⟩
  ) s_pre (Array.range batch_size)
  
  let s_pre := Tensor.clampFinite s_pre |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let s_clipped := Tensor.clip s_pre c
  let s_clipped := Tensor.clampFinite s_clipped |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let exp_s := Tensor.exp s_clipped
  let exp_s := Tensor.clampFinite exp_s |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let h_nonzero : exp_s.data.all (fun v => v ≠ 0) := by
    sorry
  
  unless h_nonzero do
    Except.error "Division by zero in backward"
  
  let x1 := Tensor.div y1 exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let x1 := Tensor.clampFinite x1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let dx1 := Tensor.mul dy1' exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let dscale := Tensor.mul dy1' x1 (by constructor <;> rfl)
  let ds := Tensor.mul dscale exp_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let ds := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let v := ds.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
    let pre := s_pre.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
    let newVal := if isFinite pre ∧ c.min ≤ pre ∧ pre ≤ c.max then v else 0
    acc.set i newVal
  ) ds.data (Array.range (batch_size * layer.dim))
  
  let ds_tensor := ⟨ds, batch_size, layer.dim, by sorry⟩
  
  let ds_w := Tensor.matmul (Tensor.transpose ds_tensor) x2 (by rfl)
  
  let s_weight_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) i =>
    let val := layer.sWeightGrad.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ + ds_w.data.get ⟨i, by omega⟩ * grad_scale
    acc.set i val
  ) layer.sWeightGrad.data (Array.range (layer.dim * layer.dim))
  
  let s_bias_grad := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Array ℝ) j =>
    let sum := Array.foldlIdx (fun (s : ℝ) i =>
      s + ds_tensor.get i j (by omega)
    ) 0 (Array.range batch_size)
    let val := layer.sBiasGrad.data.get ⟨j, by omega⟩ + sum * grad_scale
    acc.set j val
  ) layer.sBiasGrad.data (Array.range layer.dim)
  
  let s_weight_t := Tensor.transpose layer.sWeight
  let grad_from_s_t := Tensor.matmul s_weight_t (Tensor.transpose ds_tensor) (by rfl)
  let grad_from_s := Tensor.transpose grad_from_s_t
  
  let dx2 := Tensor.add dy2 grad_from_s (by constructor <;> rfl)
  
  let dx1 := Tensor.clampFinite dx1 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  let dx2 := Tensor.clampFinite dx2 |> Tensor.map (fun x => x)
  
  let newLayer := { layer with
    sWeightGrad := ⟨s_weight_grad, layer.dim, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    tWeightGrad := ⟨t_weight_grad, layer.dim, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    sBiasGrad := ⟨s_bias_grad, 1, layer.dim, by sorry⟩,
    tBiasGrad := ⟨t_bias_grad, 1, layer.dim, by sorry⟩ }
  
  pure (newLayer, x1, x2, dx1, dx2)

end RSFLayer

structure RSF where
  layers : Array RSFLayer
  dim : Nat
  numLayers : Nat
  clipMin : ℝ
  clipMax : ℝ
  gradMean : Bool := true
  h_valid : clipMin < clipMax

namespace RSF

def clipCfg (rsf : RSF) : ClipConfig :=
  { min := rsf.clipMin, max := rsf.clipMax, h_valid := rsf.h_valid }

def zeroGradients (rsf : RSF) : RSF :=
  { rsf with layers := rsf.layers.map RSFLayer.zeroGradients }

theorem zeroGradients_zero (rsf : RSF) (i : Nat) (h : i < rsf.layers.size) :
    (zeroGradients rsf).layers.get ⟨i, h⟩ = RSFLayer.zeroGradients (rsf.layers.get ⟨i, h⟩) := by
  unfold zeroGradients
  rfl

def split (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) (x1 x2 : Tensor) : Except String Nat := Id.run do
  if x.rows ≠ 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.rows ≠ x.rows ∨ x2.rows ≠ x.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.cols ≠ rsf.dim ∨ x2.cols ≠ rsf.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x.rows
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) i =>
      let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) j =>
        let val := x.get i j (by omega)
        if h : j < rsf.dim then
          x1.set i j (by omega) val
        else
          x2.set i (j - rsf.dim) (by omega) val
      ) () (Array.range (rsf.dim * 2))
    ) () (Array.range batch_size)
    Except.ok batch_size

def merge (rsf : RSF) (x1 x2 out : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if x1.rows ≠ x2.rows then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if x1.cols ≠ rsf.dim ∨ x2.cols ≠ rsf.dim then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if out.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x1.rows
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) i =>
      let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (_ : Unit) j =>
        let val1 := x1.get i j (by omega)
        let val2 := x2.get i j (by omega)
        out.set i j (by omega) val1
        out.set i (j + rsf.dim) (by omega) val2
      ) () (Array.range rsf.dim)
    ) () (Array.range batch_size)
    pure ()

theorem split_merge_id (rsf : RSF) (x x1 x2 out : Tensor) :
    rsf.split x x1 x2 = Except.ok x.rows →
    rsf.merge x1 x2 out = Except.ok () →
    ∀ i j, i < out.rows → j < out.cols →
      out.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x.get i j (by omega) (by omega) := by
  intro h_split h_merge i j h_i h_j
  cases h_split
  cases h_merge
  unfold split merge at *
  dsimp only at *
  by_cases h_j_lt : j < rsf.dim
  . unfold split at h_split
    simp at h_split
    sorry
  . sorry

theorem merge_split_id (rsf : RSF) (x x1 x2 out : Tensor) :
    rsf.merge x1 x2 out = Except.ok () →
    rsf.split out x x1 x2 = Except.ok out.rows →
    ∀ i j, i < x1.rows → j < x1.cols →
      x1.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x1.get i j (by omega) (by omega) ∧
      x2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) = x2.get i j (by omega) (by omega) := by
  intro h_merge h_split i j h_i h_j
  cases h_merge
  cases h_split
  unfold merge split at *
  dsimp only at *
  sorry

def forward (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if x.rows ≠ 2 ∨ x.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := x.rows
    let x1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let x2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split x x1 x2
    let _ := Array.foldlIdx (fun (acc : Except String (Tensor × Tensor)) i =>
      match acc with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok (cur_x1, cur_x2) =>
        let layer := rsf.layers.get ⟨i, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.forward layer cur_x1 cur_x2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok _ => Except.ok (cur_x1, cur_x2)
    ) (Except.ok (x1, x2)) (Array.range rsf.numLayers)
    let _ ← rsf.merge x1 x2 x
    pure ()

def inverse (rsf : RSF) (y : Tensor) : Except String Unit := Id.run do
  if y.rows ≠ 2 ∨ y.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := y.rows
    let y1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let y2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split y y1 y2
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (y1 y2 : Tensor) : Except String (Tensor × Tensor) :=
      if h : i > 0 then
        let layer := rsf.layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.inverse layer y1 y2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok _ => loop (i - 1) y1 y2
      else
        Except.ok (y1, y2)
    termination_by i
    decreasing_tactic
      apply Nat.pred_lt
      omega
    let _ ← loop rsf.numLayers y1 y2
    let _ ← rsf.merge y1 y2 y
    pure ()

theorem forward_inverse (rsf : RSF) (x : Tensor) :
    rsf.forward x = Except.ok () →
    match rsf.inverse x with
    | Except.ok _ => True
    | Except.error _ => False := by
  intro h_forward
  cases h_forward
  unfold forward inverse at *
  dsimp only at *
  sorry

def backward (rsf : RSF) (gradOutput input gradInput : Tensor) : Except String RSF := Id.run do
  if input.rows ≠ 2 ∨ input.cols ≠ rsf.dim * 2 then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if gradOutput.rows ≠ input.rows ∨ gradOutput.cols ≠ input.cols then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else if gradInput.rows ≠ input.rows ∨ gradInput.cols ≠ input.cols then
    Except.error "ShapeMismatch"
  else
    let batch_size := input.rows
    let x := input
    let _ ← rsf.forward x
    let y1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let y2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split x y1 y2
    let dy1 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dy2 := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let _ ← rsf.split gradOutput dy1 dy2
    let cur_y1 := y1
    let cur_y2 := y2
    let cur_dy1 := dy1
    let cur_dy2 := dy2
    let x1_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let x2_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dx1_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let dx2_prev := Tensor.zeros batch_size rsf.dim
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev : Tensor)
        (layers : Array RSFLayer) : Except String (Array RSFLayer × Tensor × Tensor) :=
      if h : i > 0 then
        let layer := layers.get ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
        match RSFLayer.backward layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok (newLayer, newX1, newX2, newDx1, newDx2) =>
          let newLayers := layers.set ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩ newLayer
          loop (i - 1) newX1 newX2 newDx1 newDx2 cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 newLayers
      else
        Except.ok (layers, cur_dy1, cur_dy2)
    termination_by i
    decreasing_tactic
      apply Nat.pred_lt
      omega
    let (newLayers, final_dy1, final_dy2) ← loop rsf.numLayers cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev rsf.layers
    let _ ← rsf.merge final_dy1 final_dy2 gradInput
    pure { rsf with layers := newLayers }

theorem backward_gradient_correctness (rsf : RSF) (gradOutput input gradInput : Tensor) :
    rsf.backward gradOutput input gradInput = Except.ok rsf →
    True := by
  intro h_back
  cases h_back
  trivial

end RSF

def xavierInit (dim : Nat) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (6 / (2 * dim))

theorem xavierInit_positive (dim : Nat) (h : dim > 0) :
    xavierInit dim > 0 := by
  unfold xavierInit
  apply Real.sqrt_pos
  linarith

def initRSFLayer (dim : Nat) (clipMin clipMax : ℝ) (gradMean : Bool) : Except String RSFLayer := Id.run do
  if dim = 0 then
    Except.error "InvalidDimension"
  else if clipMin ≥ clipMax then
    Except.error "InvalidConfig"
  else
    let xavier_bound := xavierInit dim
    let s_weight := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let t_weight := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let s_bias := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let t_bias := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let s_weight_grad := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let t_weight_grad := Tensor.zeros dim dim
    let s_bias_grad := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    let t_bias_grad := Tensor.zeros 1 dim
    pure {
      sWeight := s_weight,
      tWeight := t_weight,
      sBias := s_bias,
      tBias := t_bias,
      sWeightGrad := s_weight_grad,
      tWeightGrad := t_weight_grad,
      sBiasGrad := s_bias_grad,
      tBiasGrad := t_bias_grad,
      dim := dim,
      allocator := (),
      clipMin := clipMin,
      clipMax := clipMax,
      gradMean := gradMean,
      h_valid := by linarith [clipMin, clipMax]
    }

theorem initRSFLayer_valid (dim : Nat) (clipMin clipMax : ℝ) (gradMean : Bool) :
    dim > 0 → clipMin < clipMax →
    match initRSFLayer dim clipMin clipMax gradMean with
    | Except.ok layer => layer.dim = dim ∧ layer.clipMin = clipMin ∧ layer.clipMax = clipMax ∧ layer.gradMean = gradMean
    | Except.error _ => True := by
  intro h_dim h_clip
  unfold initRSFLayer
  split <;> split <;> split
  . contradiction
  . contradiction
  . rename_i xavier_bound s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias s_weight_grad t_weight_grad s_bias_grad t_bias_grad
    constructor <;> constructor <;> constructor <;> rfl

### A `sorry` Tactic Jelentése

### Hiányos Bizonyítások a Kódban

A beküldött kód számos kritikus helyen tartalmaz `sorry` tactic-et:

**Coupling Layer Tulajdonságok:**
- `forward_of_inverse`: A forward és inverse függvények kölcsönös inverzitását kellene bizonyítani, de több `sorry` szerepel benne

Ez a kód egy **proof-of-concept implementáció**, amely megmutatja, hogyan *lehetne* formálisan verifikálni egy Reversible Scaling Flow modellt Lean 4-ben. Azonban **nem nyújt formális garanciákat** a modell helyességére, mert a bizonyítások nem teljesek.[18][19][7]
